text:
mia_cs: Hey team — Acme Health just uploaded a vendor risk form and a DPA addendum link. They've asked specifically for KMS key provenance, SOC2 scope (prod vs non-prod), and embedding retention policy. Deadline Friday EOD. Can we triage?

jess_cs: Thanks Mia. I scanned the form — 12 questions, a couple about BYOK and subprocessor list. I can start drafting answers for the DPA Qs we already know.

sam_security: Quick answers: we do not do customer-managed BYOK for hosted, but for Private deployments we support BYOK via KMS/HSM integration. For key provenance they want a lineage doc — I can export our KM rotation and access logs. Will need infra to pull tenant-specific KMS metadata.

alan_legal: For the DPA addendum signatory we need to confirm the customer's legal contact and whether Acme requires any additional clauses beyond our standard DPA. If they want data residency carveouts we'll need product sign-off. Can someone confirm the exact addendum link they uploaded?

mia_cs: Attached link: https://acmehealth.s3/secure/vendor-forms/acro-dpa-v3.pdf (they also left a comments sheet). I'll DM the customer's legal contact.

nate_infra: @sam_security I can run the KMS provenance export. What format do you want? I can produce a CSV of key IDs, creation timestamps, rotation history, and IAM bindings. It will take me ~2 hours with current tickets.

sam_security: CSV is fine. Also include KMS key ARN and the last rotation event id. If you can include an audit log snippet showing who performed the initial import that'd help.

olivia_ops: FYI — if Acme is on a Dedicated plan we already have a BYOK playbook. If they're hosted, explain the migration path to Dedicated/private for BYOK. I can prepare a short paragraph about support timelines.

jess_cs: I'll assemble answers for the questionnaire (short bullet responses) and drop into the shared doc. Can folks review by 3pm so we can send before EOD Friday?

alan_legal: I can take a pass on the DPA language tomorrow morning. If anyone adds non-standard language, flag me.

redwood-bot: reminder: #vendor-forms-review sprint check-in in 1h — add this thread to the sprint board: https://boards.redwood/board/123

mia_cs: Perfect — plan: Nate exports KMS provenance (by 11:30), Sam and Alan review the technical + legal bits (by 1pm), Jess compiles answers and Olivia writes enablement note for Dedicated option (by 3pm). I'll coordinate and send the package to Acme legal after reviews. Thanks all :thumbsup:

jess_cs: One more ask from the questionnaire — they want tokenization/PII handling for embeddings. Sam: do we have a short blurb about token-level redaction or pseudonymization best practices?

sam_security: Short: we recommend client-side pseudonymization before embeddings for PHI, plus per-tenant embedding namespaces and retention TTLs. We do not perform automatic PII removal on customer data in hosted mode. I'll draft 3 sentences.

mia_cs: Great — I'll queue the responses. If anyone hits blockers ping me.

last note (mia_cs): filing this under the renewal risk tracker as a potential blocker if BYOK is required for them to renew. Will update deal notes after we send the response.
